issue.title: Bug: [Aspeed][pmon] hw-watchdog-mgrd IPC socket is not accessible inside pmon

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

The Aspeed watchdog platform communicates with the host `hw-watchdog-mgrd` service through the Unix socket:

`/run/hw-watchdog-mgrd.sock`

The daemon runs on the host. During sonic-mgmt Platform API test fixture runs, `platform_api_server` runs inside the `pmon` container so the watchdog API calls made by the tests execute inside that container.

 Because pmon has a separate `/run` mount namespace and `docker_image_ctl.j2` does not bind-mount the watchdog socket, arm() and disarm() cannot reach the daemon and fail with `FileNotFoundError`.

### Steps to Reproduce

Verify that the watchdog manager and socket exist on the host

```
systemctl is-active hw-watchdog-mgrd
ls -l /run/hw-watchdog-mgrd.sock
```

Inside pmon:
```
$ docker exec pmon ls -l /run/hw-watchdog-mgrd.sock
ls: cannot access '/run/hw-watchdog-mgrd.sock': No such file or directory
```

```
docker exec pmon python3 -c '
from sonic_platform.platform import Platform
watchdog = Platform().get_chassis().get_watchdog()
print(watchdog.arm(60))
'
```
`FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] No such file or directory`

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

### Actual Behaviour

When called through platform_api_server, the exception produces a null response, observed by sonic-mgmt as Python None, instead of a valid timeout or -1.

### Expected Behaviour

The watchdog IPC socket should be accessible inside pmon.

Watchdog arm, re-arm, status, remaining-time, and disarm requests originating from pmon should reach the host `hw-watchdog-mgrd` daemon and return documented values.

### Attach files (if any)

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/2005cfadac08a60032213ceca36c8cb904290d51/files/build_templates/docker_image_ctl.j2#L822

resolution.title: Issue-28715: [aspeed] Make hw-watchdog-mgrd IPC socket reachable inside pmon
resolution.description:
watchdogutil talks to the hw-watchdog-mgrd daemon over a Unix domain socket, but the socket lived directly under /run and was not visible inside the pmon container, so watchdogutil could not run there.

Move the socket into a dedicated directory
(/run/hw-watchdog-mgrd/hw-watchdog-mgrd.sock) and bind-mount that whole directory into pmon. A directory bind-mount (rather than a single-file one) keeps working across a daemon restart, which unlinks and recreates the socket inode, and does not require the socket to already exist when pmon starts.

- hw-watchdog-mgrd.py: introduce SOCKET_DIR and makedirs() it before binding the socket.
- sonic_platform/watchdog.py: update the client SOCKET_PATH to match.
- docker_image_ctl.j2: bind-mount /run/hw-watchdog-mgrd into pmon for aspeed. sysfs (/sys) is already mounted into pmon, so the is_armed() sysfs fallback works there too.

Fixes sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#28715
